aboutCards.content: A Computer Engineering fresh graduate from Universitas Syiah Kuala with a strong interest in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning. Experienced in facial image classification research and published an AI-based Down Syndrome classification study. I also have experience in leadership, teamwork, and project development through student organizations and academic projects. Passionate about building practical intelligent solutions and continuously developing my skills in AI and software development..

projects.title: Data Splitting Strategies for Down Syndrome Facial Classification: A Comparative Study Using EfficientNet-B0 and MobileNetV2
projects.description: Conducted a comparative study of Down Syndrome facial classification using EfficientNet-B0 and MobileNetV2 across 70:20:10 and 80:10:10 data-splitting strategies with five-fold cross-validation.
projects.techStack: Python, TensorFlow, Keras, OpenCV, Grad-CAM, Deep Learning

projects.title: HerbDry
projects.description: Developed HerbDry, an IoT-based herbal leaf drying system that automates and monitors the drying process in real-time. The system integrates temperature, humidity, and weight sensors with a web-based platform, enabling users to remotely monitor the drying process without constant supervision. This project was developed as the final assignment for the Hardware-Software Co-Design course.
projects.techStack: IoT, C++, Arduino IDE, Python, MicroPython, Thonny, Wokwi

projects.title: Sentiment Analysis on BYOND BSI Application
projects.description: Completed a Machine Learning internship at Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI), focusing on sentiment analysis of user reviews for the BYOND by BSI application. Collected and preprocessed textual data through data cleaning, tokenization, normalization, and feature extraction, then applied TF-IDF and SMOTE to address class imbalance. Developed and evaluated a Support Vector Machine (SVM) model to classify reviews into positive and negative sentiments and analyzed sentiment patterns to gain insights into user perceptions of the application. This experience strengthened my practical skills in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Python, text classification, and model evaluation.
